2026-11-26.title: 20th Century Boys 3: Redemption
2026-11-26.overview: The final showdown, and the final reveal. Who is Friend? How can he be stopped?

2026-11-26.title: Ju-on: The Curse 2

2026-11-26.title: Uzumaki
2026-11-26.overview: The inhabitants of a small Japanese town become increasingly obsessed with and tormented by spirals.

It combined fact and fiction to tell daring stories of professional grifters, leaving viewers with a feeling of nostalgia for the Showa era. Following that, another movie has been completed. This new live-action film, "Eat and Run - 6 Beautiful Grifters" was made with the objective of filming its main actresses as beautifully as possible. However, amid piles of fresh corpses, mounds of scorching bullet shells, and rivulets of fragrant adolescent blood, Mitsuko must fight to stay alive, before her already messed-up day becomes even stranger. But one question still remains: who or what is the enemy?

2026-11-27.title: Tokyo Family
